---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a plugin, core capability, or GUI improvement
title: ""
labels: enhancement
---

**What are you trying to do?**
A concrete use case, e.g. "I have a folder of N file type and I want to
see/search/export X about them."

**What's missing today?**
What ARIFE currently does instead (or that it can't do at all).

**Proposed solution**
If you have one in mind - a new plugin, a core feature, a GUI change.
Not required; "I don't know the right shape for this" is a fine answer.

**Would this fit as a plugin?**
If this is about extracting/showing metadata for a specific file type,
it's likely a good fit for a plugin (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`) rather than a
core change. Say if you'd be up for building it yourself.
